project_scope: Member C shared pretraining, baseline weights and evaluation for sleep consolidation and selective Hebbian memory. This controlled byte diagnostic does not reproduce paper-scale pretraining or carry persistent cross-session state.
question: Can the model fit a small finite two-key dataset, and if so does it transfer to novel value assignments and heldout key identities?

data.key_pool: First16 train keys in existing hash-ranked namespace
data.construction: Four independently permuted passes over16keys, paired adjacent; unique ordered pairs. Balanced64value assignments, all16answer letters present, pair values distinct and each key has >=2 assigned values. Deterministic rejection enforces these conditions.
data.format: Original32byte fact records and31byte query, canonical seen template0, both requested keys independently supervised.

training.sampling: Fixed bank shuffled each epoch; every context exactly once per4updates
training.objective: Full256-byte answer-position CE; no auxiliary loss
training.selection: Finalstep2000 primary; all fixedstage checkpoints saved, no best-checkpoint/seed selection

groups.novel_values: Four novel-value assignments per same ordered training key pair; both assigned letters exclude BOTH original letters. This is a deliberate per-pair value shift, not IID generalization.
groups.heldout_keys: 128 episodes using dev key namespace, canonical seen wording
groups.heldout_keys_templates: Same keys/values/seeds as heldout_keys, heldout fact+query wording; conditional template transfer on unseen keys
groups.train_query_only: Exact training queries without fact context; shorter31-byte input, diagnostic only

evaluation.memory_note: 128-window contains all95bytes; reset must be exact no-op. This is a neural-memory model with direct attention, not an independently trained attention-only baseline.

analysis.novel_value_unit: 32 baseordered key pairs with all4assignment replicates; fixedcheckpoints, no seedpooling
analysis.interpretation: Fitting success with failed novel assignments supports a task-generalization gap for this recipe. Fitting failure only establishes failure under the declared budget, not architecture impossibility.

conditional_followup.trigger: Only primary parent68101/segment128 finalstep2000; retain all original outcomes
conditional_followup.if_fit_and_novel_values_below_0.8: Two fresh-assignment runs,32/128segments, primaryoriginalparent,2000steps,16keys, samebank andbudget but new assignments everyupdate. They restart from originalparent, not selected fixed-set weights. Exploratory fixed-vs-fresh data-distribution diagnostic.
conditional_followup.if_not_fit: One tiny128 control from originalprimaryparent:8contexts,4keys,eachkey4times with>=2values,balanced16labels,1600steps. Pure fitting/complexity sanity check; no pressure baseline promotion.
conditional_followup.otherwise: No additional GPU training; record transfer evidence and remaining revision/session requirements

baseline_admission: Neither exact-set fitting nor same-key transfer alone admits a project retention baseline. Keep key identity, assignment and wording transfer distinct. Revisions, causal state/reset and cross-session behavior remain required before method claims.
